department: Department of Atmospheric and Oceanic Science

deadline.value: Apply by December 3, 2026 for priority fellowship and assistantship funding; January 5 is the standard funding deadline, and March 15 for self-funded international applicants.
deadline.quote: The fall admission application deadline for priority fellowship and assistantship funding is Dec. 3, and for standard graduate assistantship funding opportunities, applications must be submitted no later than Jan. 5.

also.quote: International Applicants F (student) or J (exchange visitor) visas; A,E,G,H,I and L visas and immigrants December 3, 2026

gre_subject.value: No subject test exists for this field.

gre_general.quote: Submission of GRE scores is optional and not required.

supervisor.value: Contact potential advisors if you want RA support in your first year.
supervisor.quote: We strongly encourage prospective students to reach out to potential academic advisors if they are interested in being supported by an RA in the first year of graduate school.

funding.value: Most students get five years of full support (tuition, benefits, stipend) via fellowships or assistantships.
funding.quote: Our students receive full support for five years (tuition, benefits, stipend) in most cases, via fellowships, research or teaching assistantships.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree (or foreign equivalent) by enrollment is enough.
entry_route.quote: Students must have successfully completed an undergraduate bachelor’s degree (or foreign equivalent) by the time of enrollment.

fee_waiver.value: AOSC does not take part in the fee waiver program, with no exceptions.
fee_waiver.quote: The AOSC Department does not participate in the fee waiver program (no exceptions).

notes: Also at UMD: Marine, Estuarine, and Environmental Sciences (MEES, deadline January 15, 2027, advisor must be identified before admission) and Environmental Science and Technology (ENST).
name: Atmospheric and Oceanic Science
